faqFreeAnswer: Yes — create your restaurant, add dishes and photos, and publish. Your menu is live as soon as you hit publish. No credit card needed to start.
faqDesignerQuestion: Do I need a designer or developer?
faqDesignerAnswer: Not at all. If you can type a dish name and price, you can build your menu. The layout and search are built in.
faqAddressQuestion: Can I use my own web address?
faqAddressAnswer: Right now your menu gets its own link — perfect for a QR code. Custom domains are coming soon, and your links will keep working.
faqQrQuestion: What happens to my QR code when I update the menu?
faqQrAnswer: Nothing — it just keeps working. Your QR points to your link. Change a price or photo and hit publish, and every table sees the new menu instantly. No need to reprint.
